text: Love the new sour cream flavor! Five stars!
Best chips ever. My kids are obsessed.
Where can I buy CrunchLab in Penang?
Do your chips contain peanuts? My son has an allergy.
Great snack, will buy again!
The BBQ flavor is amazing, please never discontinue it.
Is the seaweed flavor halal certified?
Just tried the wasabi one. WOW.
Your chips are my favorite. That's all. Have a nice day!
Can I get a poster of your mascot? My daughter loves it.
Price went up again at my local store. RM8.90 now? Really?
Why is the packet half air? Feels like I'm paying for nitrogen.
The new packaging is so hard to open, I needed scissors.
Bought a family pack, chips at the bottom were all crushed.
Delivery from your online store took 12 days. Ridiculous.
My order #4471 arrived with the wrong flavor. I ordered original, got chili.
The chips tasted stale even though expiry is next year. Batch CL2244.
Too salty lately. Did you change the recipe? Old one was better.
Promo code CRUNCH20 doesn't work at checkout. Fix it please.
Your website charged me twice for one order. Order #5518. I want a refund.

I have been buying CrunchLab for 8 years. Last month I bought six packs from three different stores in Subang Jaya and every single one tasted rancid, like old oil. Batch numbers CL2251 and CL2253. I told the store manager and he shrugged. I am switching brands unless someone explains what changed in your frying process.

As a retailer carrying your products for 5 years, I am writing to complain about the last two shipments. Cartons arrived dented, 30% of packets inside were burst, and your distributor refuses to issue credit notes. If this is not resolved by end of month we will delist CrunchLab from all 12 of our outlets.

I found a piece of hard plastic inside my chips packet. My daughter almost swallowed it. Batch CL2260, bought at TF Value Mart. This is a serious safety issue and I expect a response within 24 hours or I am going to the authorities.
There was a strong chemical smell when I opened the packet, like petrol. I felt dizzy after eating a few chips. Batch CL2249. I still have the packet as evidence.
My son bit into something sharp in the nacho flavor, it cut his gum. Looks like a fragment of metal. We kept it. Bought yesterday at Lotus's, batch number CL2262. Please advise immediately.
Crunchy perfection. 10/10.
Do you have a spicy flavor coming soon?
Just wanted to say your customer service last time was great. Thanks!
Are the chips gluten free?
My cat's name is Crunchy because of your chips lol
What time does your factory outlet store open on weekends?
The seaweed flavor is a bit bland for me but still good.
Please bring back the tomato flavor from 2023!
Saw your ad on TikTok, hilarious. Bought 3 packs because of it.
Is there a subscription option for monthly delivery?
The QR code contest on the packet doesn't scan. Tried 5 packets.
You shrank the packet from 80g to 70g but kept the price. Shrinkflation much?
My online order #6120 says delivered but nothing arrived. Neighbor didn't receive it either.
Half my packet was just crumbs. Not the premium experience you advertise.
The resealable zip on the party pack never seals properly. Chips go soft overnight.

I ordered a gift hamper for my client and it arrived after Chinese New Year, completely defeating the purpose. Your hotline kept me on hold for 40 minutes then disconnected. I need someone senior to call me back about order #5990 and I expect compensation for the embarrassment this caused with my client.

Your loyalty app deducted 4,500 points for a redemption that failed, and support keeps sending me copy-paste replies telling me to reinstall the app. I have screenshots of everything, the error codes, the transaction IDs, all of it. Three weeks now. Escalate this properly or I will post the whole saga on social media.

I compared your nutrition label with what an independent lab found and the sodium content is 40% higher than declared. I am a nutritionist and I am considering reporting this to the food safety authority. I would like your quality team to respond with an explanation of your testing methodology.

The chips are fine but the oil used seems different, my whole family got mild stomach aches after the movie night pack. Might be coincidence, might not. Batch CL2255. Just letting you know in case others report the same.
There is mold inside my sealed packet. Green fuzzy spots on several chips. Expiry says March 2027 so this should not happen. Batch CL2258, bought at 99 Speedmart. I have photos.
New flavor suggestion: salted egg! Everyone in Malaysia would buy it.
Your delivery rider was super polite. Give that man a raise.
Packet says WIN A TRIP but the contest page is 404. Is the contest still on?
Chips arrived melted together somehow? Like they got hot in transit. Order #6003.
Honestly just the best snack in the world. Sorry for spamming your inbox, not sorry.
